title: Finish Canonical Run ID Validation for Audit Packages

already_fixed: JSON and JSONL readers reuse structured text read error handling
invalid UTF-8 in JSON files has regression coverage
context.remaining_blocker: run_id validation still recursively scans arbitrary nested dictionaries/lists through _find_run_ids, which can falsely reject valid packages containing metadata, baseline, reference, or comparison run IDs.
context.principle: Governance should validate canonical evidence fields, not every incidental nested key named run_id. Precision beats paranoia.

task.summary: Remove recursive run_id scanning and validate only canonical audit-package run_id locations.
task.user_story: As an Ailuros maintainer, I want audit-package run_id consistency checks to inspect only canonical package fields, so metadata or baseline references do not create false governance failures.
non_goals: Do not change summary.md error handling again unless tests prove it is broken.
Do not redesign package loading or parse aggregation.
Do not change PASS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, FAIL semantics.
Do not touch exporter formatting or unrelated CLI formatting.
Do not add HTTP API, dashboard, runtime ingestion, runtime blocking, auth, session, policy DSL, or reference-app concepts.

required_changes: Implement _collect_run_ids so it reads only manifest.run_id, run.run_id, and direct run_id fields from timeline, decisions, evaluations, and regressions list records.
Do not inspect nested dict/list values inside metadata, payload, baseline, comparison, referenced, previous, evidence, or any other nested object.
Keep required run_id validation for manifest.json and run.json.
Keep direct canonical mismatch detection for timeline[*].run_id, decisions[*].run_id, evaluations[*].run_id, and regressions[*].run_id.
Preserve existing decision precedence and CLI behavior.

acceptance_criteria: _collect_run_ids no longer calls any recursive helper over arbitrary nested values.
A package with decisions[*].metadata.run_id different from canonical run_id still returns PASS when all canonical fields match.
A package with evaluations[*].baseline.run_id or regressions[*].reference.run_id different from canonical run_id still returns PASS when all canonical fields match.
A package with timeline[*].run_id different from manifest/run run_id still returns FAIL.
A package with decisions[*].run_id different from manifest/run run_id still returns FAIL.
Existing invalid UTF-8 and parse aggregation tests continue to pass.

notes: If full pytest still fails due to known unrelated Clarify/release smoke baseline failures, report exact failing tests and do not mark full validation green.

must_check: Recursive arbitrary nested run_id scanning is removed from validation behavior.
Canonical direct run_id mismatches still fail deterministically.
Nested non-canonical run_id-like values do not fail validation.
Tests cover nested metadata/reference/baseline run_id false-positive prevention.
Tests cover direct canonical timeline or decisions run_id mismatch still failing.
Existing summary.md structured error handling remains intact.
No forbidden paths or reference-app concepts are introduced.
All validation commands are run and reported honestly.
reject_if: _collect_run_ids still calls _find_run_ids or any recursive arbitrary nested scanner.
Nested metadata.run_id, baseline.run_id, reference.run_id, or equivalent non-canonical values can still cause FAIL.
Canonical mismatch checks are weakened or removed.
The patch touches src/ailuros/cli.py, exporter formatting, docs, or unrelated architecture files without a proven need.
Tests are deleted or loosened instead of adding focused regression coverage.
Validation failures are hidden or reported as success.
